nom: Clinique 7 Day Face Scrub Cream Rinse-Off Formula

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily acne-prone skin report reduced breakouts and less visible oil over time, though one long-term user still experienced flaking despite oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some with dry flaky cheeks, generally report the scrub softens skin without stripping or over-drying it, with one describing it as the only product that has worked for her dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (oily T-zone, dry cheeks) report the scrub balances both areas, reducing flakiness while controlling oil.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, report no irritation and gentle exfoliation, but a few say the granules felt rough, scratchy, or outright painful on sensitive skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer explicitly recommends the product for normal to dry skin as a twice-weekly exfoliator.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older (50s-70s) or long-term users report smoother, more youthful-looking skin and improved pores with continued use.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother skin, improved pores, and a more youthful look with regular use; one notes fine lines are minimized though still present.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or flaky skin say the scrub softens and hydrates without stripping, though one reviewer says it did not help remove her dry flakes.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report no increase in redness and even some reduction, but a minority found the granules rough enough to feel like irritation risk.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers generally say the formula does not leave skin feeling tight, dry, or stripped after rinsing, supporting comfortable everyday use.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers mention fewer little bumps or improved skin tone after use, with no reports of the product worsening spots.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts and more controlled acne with regular use; however, one reviewer with acne-prone sensitive skin reports the full-size product caused repeated, worsening breakouts despite the sample size working fine.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report a visible reduction in oil and shine over time, with one noting the scrub removes excess oil while leaving skin soft.

aspects.libelle: Hard to rinse off, greasy residue

extraits.titre: I wanted to like it, but...
extraits.texte: I have incredibly dry, sensitive skin with flushing/rosacea and frequent acne. I got a sample size of this scrub and used it for a week, and my skin looked and felt improved. So I got the full size one, thinking I'd finally found something my skin didn't hate. How wrong I was! First use of the full size bottle, and my face broke out all over. Tried it again, more breakouts. Used it for a week, worse skin than ever before. Stopped for a week or so to give my skin a break, used the sample size again with no issues. Tried the big size yet again, skin got awful again. All I can figure is that maybe somehow the formula was different in the small size vs the large size? Whatever the case, I wasted a chunk of money and it's too late now to return it.
This face scrub felt really rough on my skin! It hurt to rub in. I would not recommend this if you have sensitive skin like me.

When I was in my twenties through my early fourties' I disliked this scrub because I always felt it was on the oily side. My favorite product in this category was the exfoliating scrub with a bit more abrasive texture and minty tingle. As I approach my late fourties' my oily, acne prone skin has since developed a sensitivity to most products. I ran out of my exfoliating scrub and avoided using scrubs thinking it would help with my skin issues. On a whim I tried the seven day scrub that was part of a gift with purchase. I was blown away by the results. The seven day scrub gives me the exfoliation that my skin craves with just a touch of moisture to keep the sensitivity at bay. This scrub compliments the three step program for "number 4" oily acne prone skin beautifully. The scrub is gentle enough to use daily with no issues. My skin glows and the number of breakouts have diminished and my skin texture is extremely smooth. I regret not trying this skincare combo sooner. Sometimes a slow and steady approach to skincare wins the race.

extraits.titre: Finally, something my skin doesn't hate!
extraits.texte: I got this 2 weeks ago from Ulta on the recommendation of an older employee who actually took the time to ask about my skin. I have combo (oily T-area / stupid dry cheeks and brows, like flakey tight) and ultra sensitive skin. She recommended to add this to my routine 2-3 times a week to help get rid of those pesty flakes around my oily nose and help my dry skin take in my moisturizing products better...and wow. My skin feels so so soft! I haven't found an exfoliator that hasn't irritated or overdried my skin until now-- this is insane to be honest. The skin around my nose is actually smooth....I feel like maybe I can actually wear makeup again without the flaking! 2 weeks in, I'm super happy

extraits.titre: Subtle and gentle but works so well!
extraits.texte: My skin is so dry and flaky. I also have rosacea so it's also sensitive. I bought this to help exfoliate and brighten my skin and it has done just that, in less than a week! And it has not irritated my rosacea at all. In fact, it looks better than it has for a while. I got the sample size and will definitely be buying the full size soon! The exfoliant is so subtle but does its job perfectly. I have paired this with the Moisture Surge Intense face cream and my face is so soft.

I've tried numerous scrubs labeled "for sensitive skin", and all of them just irritated mine even more. I have sensitive skin and rosacea. This scrub doesn't irritate either. I know sensitive skin should use chemical exfoliants (per the experts), but I just can't bring myself to do that. I knew if I kept searching that I'd find a non-chemical one that would work, and this is it. I use it maybe once every two weeks when I want a clean slate. I will buy this for as long as they make it!

extraits.titre: I would buy this product always.
extraits.texte: Been using this for many years, it is the best for getting rid of dead skin and flaking. I have had oily skin for most of my life and still got flaking. Cannot go without this product since I need to use it daily.
